research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Instawork is researching and developing a Booking Engine that predicts cancellations of booked events. This system utilizes various methods and computer program products to generate predictions for distinct sequential time ranges before an event starts. This technology aims to enhance the efficiency and reliability of staffing solutions by anticipating potential disruptions in bookings. Instawork's focus is on improving the predictability and management of gig work and hospitality staffing through advanced predictive analytics.

overview_description.description:
Instawork operates as a career marketplace for hospitality professionals. It is changing how traditional recruiting works for small businesses by turning the process into an automated matching solution. Its vision is to create economic opportunity for local businesses and professionals, globally. 

The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Instawork is an on-demand staffing app for gig workers and hospitality businesses.

product.name: Instawork Staffing Platform
product.description: A web and mobile staffing marketplace that connects businesses with vetted hourly workers for shifts and temporary assignments, with matching, scheduling, timekeeping, payroll, billing, and support.

product.name: Short-Term Temporary Workers
product.description: Temporary staffing for one-off shifts, events, seasonal demand, and other immediate workforce requirements.

product.name: Long-Term Temporary Workers
product.description: Multi-week and recurring temporary staffing for project-based work or ongoing operational coverage.

product.name: Permanent Workers
product.description: Recruiting and hiring support for businesses seeking permanent team members from Instawork’s pool of vetted hourly workers.

product.name: Instawork Robotics Lab
product.description: A robotics workforce service that connects businesses and robotics developers with workers who collect training data and support robot deployment and maintenance.
